"""IVX progressive load test — safe read-only endpoints only. No registrations, no writes."""
import sys, time, json, statistics, concurrent.futures, urllib.request, ssl

STAGE = int(sys.argv[1])          # concurrent users
REQS_PER_USER = int(sys.argv[2])  # requests each
ENDPOINTS = [
    "https://api.ivxholding.com/health",
    "https://api.ivxholding.com/api/landing-config",
    "https://ivxholding.com/ivx-config.json",
]
ctx = ssl.create_default_context()

def one_user(uid):
    lat, errs, timeouts = [], 0, 0
    for i in range(REQS_PER_USER):
        url = ENDPOINTS[(uid + i) % len(ENDPOINTS)]
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=15, context=ctx) as r:
                r.read(512)
                if r.status != 200:
                    errs += 1
        except TimeoutError:
            timeouts += 1
        except Exception:
            errs += 1
        lat.append((time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000)
    return lat, errs, timeouts

t_start = time.monotonic()
all_lat, tot_err, tot_to = [], 0, 0
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=STAGE) as ex:
    for lat, errs, tos in ex.map(one_user, range(STAGE)):
        all_lat.extend(lat); tot_err += errs; tot_to += tos
dur = time.monotonic() - t_start
n = len(all_lat)
all_lat.sort()
q = lambda p: all_lat[min(n - 1, int(n * p))]
print(json.dumps({
    "stage": STAGE, "total_requests": n, "duration_s": round(dur, 1),
    "throughput_rps": round(n / dur, 1),
    "p50_ms": round(statistics.median(all_lat)), "p95_ms": round(q(0.95)), "p99_ms": round(q(0.99)),
    "max_ms": round(all_lat[-1]), "errors": tot_err, "timeouts": tot_to,
    "error_rate_pct": round(100 * (tot_err + tot_to) / n, 2),
}))
